answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 69 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 14 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 69 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 380 bought sponsors, each risking real money. The thread of the design is public, the yarrow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the quill of honest work is what finally pays.
